p.i: Reddendum est quicquid mundi bene postulat ordo, Propositum, piæ non violat fidei. Mutibus & sanctis nulla est spernenda potestas, Æquum seruire est regibus & dominis. Vt Christi famulis ad verum prosit honorem, Dilexisse bonos & tolerâsse malos.

main_text.head: CAP. VIII. De obedientia Orthodoxorum omnium, im-primis vero Romanorum pontificum erga Anastasium Imperator. Eutychianum:
main_text.p: Antequam Anastasij Imperatoris res gestas aggrediar, operæpretium erit in transitu, Valentiani Iunioris, qui in Occidente imperauit interitum, & pariter in Regicidam Dei unidictam, breuiter enarrare. Occisus igitur est Valentianus in campo Martio ({i}ait Cassi-odorus) dolo Maximi (addit Marcelli-nus) per Ostiam & Transtilam satellites; causam verò cur insidias Imperatoris vitæi utriq[?] in Chron.

page.notes: Left margin note at foot: "utriq;" read with [?]. Reference mark "i" appears twice in the text ("ait", "addit"); the margin note is set once, beside the first. Long s is printed as s and is transcribed as s. Text is printed in italic where marked; the title line and "Cap. VIII." are set as one heading.
